shows: Front cover. Alex (lavender-white bunny, sunflower-yellow hoodie, blue shorts, orange sneakers) stands on the meadow hill holding the string of a red-and-yellow diamond kite high in a windy blue sky. Nutty the orange squirrel clings to Alex's shoulder, tail streaming in the wind. Captain Caution (brown owl hero, green mask and cape, gold shield emblem) glides in the sky behind the kite. Leave calm space at the top for the title.

alt.en: Alex the bunny flies a red kite on a windy hill, with Nutty the squirrel and Captain Caution the owl hero in the sky.
alt.es: Alex vuela una cometa roja en una colina con viento, con la ardilla Nutty y el Capitán Cautela, el búho héroe, en el cielo.

size: 1800x1200 px (3:2), WebP. Keep faces and the key action inside the middle 70% of the width: wide screens crop the sides a little to fill the left page.

shows: Wide establishing shot of Sunny Meadow Park on a windy afternoon: tall grass bending, the windmill on the far hill spinning, clouds racing, the pink castle and rainbow far away. Under the blossom tree, Dad (tall grey-lilac bunny, floppy straw sun hat with a red band, green striped polo) spreads a gingham picnic blanket with a basket and lemonade. Alex holds the folded kite, ears blowing in the wind.

alt.en: A windy day at Sunny Meadow Park. Dad and Alex stand on the picnic blanket, and Alex holds the red kite.
alt.es: Un día de viento en el Parque Pradera Soleada. Papá y Alex están en la manta de picnic, y Alex sostiene la cometa roja.

size: 1800x1200 px (3:2), WebP. Keep faces and the key action inside the middle 70% of the width: wide screens crop the sides a little to fill the left page.

shows: Comic moment: Nutty the squirrel rides a giant oak leaf through the air like a surfboard, arms out, grinning ("Wheee!"), with a second small inset-like motion of him landing tail-first in the grass, an acorn bonking his head. Big oak tree behind. Funny, never hurt.

alt.en: Nutty the squirrel flies through the air holding a big leaf, while an acorn falls toward him.
alt.es: La ardilla Nutty vuela por el aire con una hoja grande, mientras una bellota cae hacia él.

size: 1800x1200 px (3:2), WebP. Keep faces and the key action inside the middle 70% of the width: wide screens crop the sides a little to fill the left page.

shows: Alex stands on the hill holding the kite string with both hands, leaning back happily, looking up. The red-and-yellow diamond kite is tiny and high among the clouds, its tail of bows flicking. Dad sits on the picnic blanket behind, tipping back his straw hat to watch and cheering.

alt.en: Alex holds the kite string and laughs at the red kite high in the sky. Dad tips his straw hat and smiles.
alt.es: Alex sostiene el hilo y se ríe mirando la cometa roja muy alta. Papá se toca el sombrero de paja y sonríe.

size: 1800x1200 px (3:2), WebP. Keep faces and the key action inside the middle 70% of the width: wide screens crop the sides a little to fill the left page.

shows: Two-shot at the picnic blanket. Dad stands with the picnic basket in one hand and holds up one finger for "our rule", smiling and goofy. Alex, still holding the kite string, scrunches one ear while thinking hard. Kite visible in the sky.

alt.en: Dad holds a snack box and raises one hand to remind Alex of their rule. Alex holds the kite string and thinks hard.
alt.es: Papá sostiene una caja de merienda y levanta una mano para recordarle a Alex su regla. Alex sostiene el hilo y piensa mucho.

size: 1800x1200 px (3:2), WebP. Keep faces and the key action inside the middle 70% of the width: wide screens crop the sides a little to fill the left page.

shows: A powerful gust sweeps over the hill (visible swirls of wind, petals and leaves flying). The kite string zips out of Alex's grip; Alex reaches up with both arms, mouth open in an "Oh no!", ears blown back. The kite flips over and over across the sky.

alt.en: A big gust of wind pulls the kite away. Alex reaches up with a surprised face as the kite tumbles across the sky.
alt.es: Una ráfaga fuerte se lleva la cometa. Alex estira los brazos con cara de sorpresa mientras la cometa da vueltas por el cielo.

size: 1800x1200 px (3:2), WebP. Keep faces and the key action inside the middle 70% of the width: wide screens crop the sides a little to fill the left page.

shows: The kite cartwheels low over the meadow toward the far edge of the park. Nutty races after it like an orange rocket, tail streaming ("Squirrel speed!"). Alex has run only a few steps and glances back over a shoulder at Dad, who is still in sight at the blanket, waving.

alt.en: Alex runs after the kite and looks back at Dad, who can still see Alex from the picnic blanket. Nutty races ahead.
alt.es: Alex corre tras la cometa y mira hacia papá, que todavía puede ver a Alex desde la manta. Nutty corre adelante.

size: 1800x1200 px (3:2), WebP. Keep faces and the key action inside the middle 70% of the width: wide screens crop the sides a little to fill the left page.

shows: The park's edge: a path, a wooden bench, a lamp post, a low hedge and a small dusty soft-blue car in the parking area at the left. The grown-up Alex doesn't know, a friendly ordinary goat (blue cardigan, round glasses, khaki pants), stoops to pick up the kite by the bench and smiles. He must look ordinary and kind, never scary.

alt.en: By a bench at the edge of the park, a goat in a blue sweater and round glasses picks up the kite and smiles.
alt.es: Junto a una banca en la orilla del parque, una cabra con suéter azul y lentes redondos levanta la cometa y sonríe.

size: 1800x1200 px (3:2), WebP. Keep faces and the key action inside the middle 70% of the width: wide screens crop the sides a little to fill the left page.

shows: Close on Alex and Nutty, a few big hops away from the goat (who stays small in the background holding the kite). Nutty is on Alex's shoulder whispering behind his paw, tail puffed up like a bottle brush; the orange "notice" spark (star with a "!") pops over the goat. Alex's ears droop, unsure.

alt.en: Nutty sits by Alex with his tail puffed up, and an orange star pops up to say: notice this! The goat stands by the bench holding the kite.
alt.es: Nutty está junto a Alex con la cola esponjada, y aparece una estrella naranja que dice: ¡fíjate! La cabra está junto a la banca con la cometa.

size: 1800x1200 px (3:2), WebP. Keep faces and the key action inside the middle 70% of the width: wide screens crop the sides a little to fill the left page.

shows: Alex stands with both feet planted about two big hops away from the goat, watching calmly. Far behind on the hill, Dad is clearly visible at the picnic blanket (show the line of sight). The goat sets the kite down gently on the grass.

alt.en: Alex stays back by the hedge, far from the goat. The goat puts the kite down on the bench. Far away on the hill, Dad can still see Alex.
alt.es: Alex se queda atrás junto al seto, lejos de la cabra. La cabra deja la cometa en la banca. Lejos, en la colina, papá todavía puede ver a Alex.

size: 1800x1200 px (3:2), WebP. Keep faces and the key action inside the middle 70% of the width: wide screens crop the sides a little to fill the left page.

shows: Alex stands tall, one hand up in a polite "no thank you" gesture, a clear, firm but friendly face. The goat looks a little surprised and says "Oh. Okay." Candy still in the goat's hand.

alt.en: Alex holds up one hand like a stop sign and says, "No, thank you!" The goat looks surprised.

shows: Alex runs across the meadow toward the blossom tree and Dad, ears streaming, determined, mouth open calling "I'm going to my dad!". Nutty bounds alongside. The goat and the car are small and far behind.

alt.en: Alex runs up the meadow toward Dad, with Nutty bounding alongside.
alt.es: Alex corre por la pradera hacia papá, con Nutty saltando a su lado.

shows: Dad kneels and wraps Alex in a big, warm hug; Alex's drooping ears are lifting back up. Nutty hugs Dad's hat. Warm light.

alt.en: Dad gives Alex a big, warm hug, and they both laugh. Nutty smiles nearby.
alt.es: Papá le da a Alex un abrazo grande y cálido, y los dos se ríen. Nutty sonríe cerca.

alt.es: Alex vuela otra vez la cometa roja y se ríe, con papá muy cerca.
